_comment: Display data for the hub page and README. Install details live in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. Keys must match marketplace plugin names. Run `node scripts/sync.mjs` after editing.

iceberg.title: iceberg
iceberg.summary: Hemingway writing rules for technical docs
iceberg.blurb: Scores and rewrites technical documentation using 14 Hemingway-based rules. Runs automatically on every plan.

html.title: html
html.blurb: Generates rich, self-contained HTML reports, slide decks, kanban boards, and timelines in the Birchline design system.

memory-sync.title: memory-sync
memory-sync.summary: Claude Code memory backup and sync
memory-sync.blurb: Backs up and restores per-project Claude Code memory to a private Git repo. HOME-relative storage works across machines.

typescript-patterns-enforcer.title: TypeScript Patterns Enforcer
typescript-patterns-enforcer.blurb: Enforces TypeScript best practices inline while editing, plus a dedicated subagent for PR reviews and refactors. Formerly ts-patterns.

deck-visuals.title: deck-visuals
deck-visuals.summary: Inline-SVG diagrams, dataviz charts, icons, and GIF levity for HTML decks
deck-visuals.blurb: Guides and injects impactful visuals into HTML decks — inline-SVG concept diagrams, dataviz-backed charts, icon anchors, and sourced-and-verified GIF levity — without rendering the deck itself.

tricorder.title: tricorder
tricorder.summary: Statusline + macOS menu-bar app for Claude Code sessions — context gauge, PRs, running sub-agents, attention sounds
tricorder.blurb: Full sensor sweep of your Claude Code sessions — an always-on statusline, a Starfleet away-team view in your macOS menu bar, and configurable attention sounds. macOS + iTerm2.

pr-brief.title: pr-brief
pr-brief.summary: Readable PR descriptions: a brief, Input → Functions → Output diagrams, and a ranked review guide — plus a gate that blocks descriptions without them
pr-brief.blurb: Makes large pull requests readable — a short brief, Input → Functions → Output diagrams, and a ranked list of the files to review first — and blocks PR descriptions that lack them.

unmistakable.title: unmistakable
unmistakable.summary: English an AI agent cannot misread: a rewrite skill and a linter that follow the ASD-STE100 rules
unmistakable.blurb: Rewrites English so an AI agent cannot misread it — tool descriptions, error messages, PR text — and checks the result with a linter. Follows the ASD-STE100 rules.

plugin-directory-preflight.title: Plugin Directory Preflight
plugin-directory-preflight.summary: Run the directory's upload checks locally, read the scan report in a screenful, and pin a stubborn hold
plugin-directory-preflight.blurb: Runs the plugin directory's upload checks on your machine, reads the scan report in a screenful, and pins a stubborn hold with a throwaway probe repo in about three uploads.

foghorn.title: foghorn
foghorn.summary: Technical release notes in a configurable voice: each entry says what changed, shows the old and new output, says who is affected and credits contributors
foghorn.blurb: Drafts release notes for a tag range in a configurable voice. Each entry says what changed, shows the old and new output, says who is affected and credits the people who helped. A checker lints the result.

greenhorn.title: greenhorn
greenhorn.summary: Rewrites technical text for a reader who has never seen your system: finds where a stranger gets lost, answers each gap from your code, leads with one real example
greenhorn.blurb: Rewrites technical text for a reader who has never seen your system. A cold reader finds where a stranger gets lost, each gap is answered from your code, and one real example comes first.
